serverInfo.name: @guardbee/mcp-slopsquat-scanner
serverInfo.description: MCP server that checks every dependency declared in package.json/requirements.txt/pyproject.toml against the real npm/PyPI registry -- flags names that don't exist at all (likely LLM-hallucinated dependencies an attacker may have pre-registered) and names that exist but were only very recently published

tools.name: scan_npm
tools.description: Check every dependency declared in a package.json against the real npm registry -- flags hallucinated/nonexistent package names and suspiciously new ones.

directory.description: Path to the directory containing package.json

tools.name: scan_pip
tools.description: Check every dependency declared in requirements.txt or pyproject.toml against the real PyPI registry -- flags hallucinated/nonexistent package names and suspiciously new ones.

directory.description: Path to the directory containing requirements.txt or pyproject.toml

tools.name: check_package
tools.description: Check a single package name against the real npm or PyPI registry

tools.name: scan_directory
tools.description: Auto-detect and check both npm and pip manifests in a directory against their real registries

directory.description: Path to the project root directory
